about_the_game:
Tezcatlipoca began as a low-poly video game project, born out of the technical and artistic limitations of its creator, Luis Eduardo Sánchez Mora.
But instead of seeing simplicity as a constraint, this creative journey revealed it as a source of beauty, expression, and freedom.

This artbook captures the visual evolution of the project: from early sketches and color tests to the final scenes that shaped a world inspired by Mesoamerican mysticism.
A tribute to the process, to mistakes, and to the magic that emerges when one creates with what they have at hand.

content_descriptors.notes:
This artbook complements the visual development of the game Tezcatlipoca and is intended for an adult audience.
It features low poly artistic material that supports the game's narrative and atmosphere.

Included content:
Low poly models of nude female bodies, designed as part of the game's world and tone.

Scenes with stylized blood and violence, integrated into the story as part of the visual language of horror.

All content was created with an artistic and narrative focus.
It is not meant to provoke shock or display gratuitous violence, but rather to represent mature themes within the context of an adult horror game.
Due to its nature, this material is not suitable for minors.
